stem: The MRR of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, rose from €40,000 in February to €41,000 in March. Which statement must be true?

options.text: MRR gained from new, upgraded and returning businesses beat MRR lost by €1,000
No business cancelled or downgraded its Business Care plan during March
Business Care had more active businesses at the end of March than of February
The average monthly fee per active business was higher in March than in February
